sloka: अब्रवीच्च विमानस्थः पूजयन् सर्ववानरान् ।सुग्रीवं च महावीर्यं काकुत्स्थः सविभीषणम् ।। ६.१२५.१४ ।।
transliteration: abravīcca vimānasthaḥ pūjayan sarvavānarān ।sugrīvaṁ ca mahāvīryaṁ kākutsthaḥ savibhīṣaṇam ।। 6.125.14 ।।

translations.english: "Bull among Vanaras! Since this work of the friend has been accomplished, you too have my permission to go where you will."
